它们夜里从滑道爬上来。当心鱼市。

content.cast.the-lighthouse.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 点灯。然后到滑道阶梯来找我。
content.cast.the-narrows.ivo-marrack.0.bark.0: 舵柄在近处那屋里。我的人要是还有气，就带回来。
content.cast.the-narrows.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 把他带回来。把你们自己也带回来。
content.cast.the-pier.absalom-tregear.0.bark.0: 你们怎么处置它，我都会写下来。
content.cast.the-rubbing.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 石头是什么，特里加尔会告诉你。需要的话就把他叫醒。
content.cast.the-run.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 把他带回来。你们也回来。

content.class.physician.blurb: 支援。向队伍投掷治疗喷溅药水；配剑和轻皮甲。
content.class.physician.name: 医师
content.class.reporter.blurb: 远程。后排用弩，近身用剑，还有望远镜观察。
content.class.reporter.name: 记者
content.class.scholar.blurb: 轻装战士。剑、皮甲锁甲，还有清理旧石刻的刷子。
content.class.scholar.kit.5.name: 学者之刷
content.class.scholar.name: 学者
content.class.veteran.blurb: 前排。剑盾重铁甲：慢，但极难杀死。
content.class.veteran.name: 老兵
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-carvers.text: 一个没人记得的民族，比这座镇子还早。第二块石板下面有一行他们自己的文字。我一直读不懂。
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-panels.text: 人们把石头砸进它的脑袋。然后探海者睡着，做梦，梦漫到岸上。然后人们抬起石头，探海者沉入海沟。抬起石头，就是把它送下去。
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-row.text: 最下面那排。在我祖父之前就断掉了。我不知道上面刻的是什么。这比其他部分更让我害怕。
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-rubbing.text: 文娜让你们来的。那我就告诉你们。这是拓片：我祖父从额石上取下来的，就是钉进探海者脑袋里、刻满花纹的那块石头。那块石头底部断掉了。
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.opt.0.label: 她在等你。
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.text: 我不知道怎么到这儿的。我什么都不记得了。我母亲没事吧？
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.opt.0.label: 戴维。你妈妈。
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.text: 戴维睁着眼站在心脏旁。“这里很暖和。它在做梦，我们梦见它。躺下。躺在它旁边，就快到时间了。”
content.dlg.davey-home.davey-home.text: “我不记得那间公寓，别的也都不记得了。妈妈说你大老远专程来找我。谢谢你。”
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.opt.0.label: 怎么过去？
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.text: 那你们是要进里面去。我进去过。口子在低处开着。我带了两个人进去，一个人出来，他们还在里面。不知道他们是死是活。
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.opt.0.tool: 马拉克把小船借给你，把他的日志也给了你。
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.text: 我的小船在路尽头的老渡屋里。拿去用。我的日志也拿去；上面记着我看到的。要找到我的人，带他们出来。
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.opt.0.label: 我们在找一个男孩
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.text: “伊沃·马拉克。彭哈洛来的，干打捞的。三天前坐船来，要在别人之前把那东西剥了。”
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.0.label: 我们在找一个男孩
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.1.label: 你是谁？
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.text: “又一群冲着尸体来的？掉头回去。”他正眼看了看你。“……不。你们不是来打捞的。”
content.dlg.sleeper-lofts.sleeper-lofts.text: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.sleeper-ropewalk.sleeper-ropewalk.te: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.sleeper-street-1.sleeper-street-1.te: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.sleeper-street-2.sleeper-street-2.te: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.text: 现在拉克姆每个人都做同样的梦。你走上泥滩，躺在它旁边。然后睡着的人就真的做了。天亮时，我们大都在水边找到他们。三个人走进了水里。戴维就是其中之一。我怕那个梦。我不敢睡。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-fathomer.text: “这是拉克姆的老叫法，指海湾外海沟里睡着的那个东西。他们说它头里有块石头。教堂里的阿布萨隆·特雷加尔知道那是什么石头。去问他。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.0.label: 探渊者？
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.1.label: 返回
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.text: “四天前的夜里，海湾底翻了上来。两英里长的黑泥，正好横在港口入口。有个东西跟着一起升上来，在远处的边缘。有一座小山那么大。老人们叫它探渊者。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.0.label: 滩涂上有什么？
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.1.label: 在睡梦中？
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.2.label: 我们会找到他。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.text: “你们来了。好。我是温娜·科伊尔，港务长。我在报纸上登了启事。四天前夜里，我儿子戴维在睡梦中走上滩涂，再没回来。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.label: 留着它
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.tooltip: 特雷加尔把石头锁进教堂地窖，谁也再不能把它放回去。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.label: 还回去
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.tooltip: 石头从码头尽头落入海中，回到它来的地方。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.text: “你把他带回来了。”她抓着戴维的胳膊不放。“那块石头。特雷加尔说，要是它回到海里，那东西就会沉回去。要是你们留着，就谁也再放不回去了。你们说了算。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-slipway.text: “灯已经点亮了。那就是古道；人们说它不会陷下去。顺着木桩走到黑水那边。把他带回来。”
content.fx.the-cathedral.oc.the-stomach.0.narrat: 黑色水潭岸边：两盏灯、一只靴子、一卷绳子、两件外套。
content.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chart.0.narr: 海图显示一条跨过海湾、比小镇还古老的路：朝圣者之路。木桩标出路线，灯塔曾为它们点亮。
content.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chip.0.seq.1: 有那么一会儿，你走在温热的黑泥上，想在某样东西旁边躺下。
content.fx.the-harbourmistress.done.1.narrate: 温娜·科伊尔把海关大楼钥匙给了你。
content.fx.the-heart.oc.davey.2.narrate: 心壁上有三个阀门。外面，一根触手从侧腹的一处伤口里冒了出来。
content.fx.the-lighthouse.oc.light-the-lamp.6.na: 滩涂上的灯一盏接一盏亮了起来。
content.fx.the-lighthouse.oc.light-the-lamp.7.na: 泥滩上，一排灯一直延伸到黑水边。黄雾现在笼罩了整个下城。
content.fx.the-narrows.oc.the-narrows.2.narrate: 路旁有什么东西升了起来。
content.fx.the-narrows.oc.the-narrows.3.narrate: 一根触手从路旁泥地的一个坑里伸出来，打在一旁的岩架上。
content.fx.the-pier.done.0.seq.1.0.narrate: 黎明时分，镇子晴朗，海湾有雾。拉克姆没人做梦。特里吉尔没有睡：他小教堂下面的石头在做梦，他听得见。
content.fx.the-pier.done.1.seq.1.0.narrate: 下沉时，石头第一次露出最下面一行：拉克姆，没入水中。黎明时雾还未散。拉克姆没人做梦。
content.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-shipwright-no: 纸条上写着：涨潮那晚，滩涂封住了港口入口。没有船能离开拉克姆。对岸唯一的船是一位叫马拉克的船长的打捞艇，他三天前从海路来的。
content.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-spade.1.narra: 剥鲸铲：一把捕鲸人的长刀，锋利得能从肉里剜出石头。
content.fx.the-throat.oc.into-the-mouth.0.narrat: 一颗牙上用粉笔画着箭头，指向里面。马拉克是从这儿进去的。
content.fx.the-wreck-field.done.4.narrate: 路两边开阔的泥地陷了下去，海水漫了上来。
content.fx.trig.cathedral-tentacle-east-struck.3: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.cathedral-tentacle-west-struck.3: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.crown-tentacle-1-struck.3.narrat: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.crown-tentacle-2-struck.3.narrat: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.crown-tentacle-3-struck.3.narrat: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.customs-door.0.narrate: 门锁着。海关大楼的钥匙能打开它：温娜·科伊尔把它放在港务办公室。
content.fx.trig.diaphragm-sealed.0.narrate: 一堵坚韧的膜壁。用剥皮铲抵住它就能割开。
content.fx.trig.far-bell.1.narrate: 小艇从雾中回来接你，把你渡过去。
content.fx.trig.far-door-sealed.0.narrate: 门从里面上了闩。来这里的船走的是水路。
content.fx.trig.far-tiller.0.seq.1.2.sealed_hint: 渡船屋关着。拉响门旁的铃，跟其他人到对岸去。
content.fx.trig.jaw-tentacle-east-struck.3.narra: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.jaw-tentacle-west-struck.3.narra: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.narrows-tentacle-struck.3.narrat: 触手缩回黑暗里，不再出来。
content.fx.trig.near-bell.1.narrate: 小艇从雾中回来接你，把你渡过去。
content.fx.trig.near-tiller.0.seq.1.1.sealed_hin: 渡口小屋的门关着。摇响门边的铃，跟上其他人过河。
content.fx.trig.pillar-script.0.narrate: 和拓片下方一样的小刻痕。这里没人能读懂。
content.fx.trig.rubbing-script.0.narrate: 第二块镶板下有一排小刻痕，用的是一种拉克姆没人能读的文字。
content.fx.trig.slipway-sealed.0.narrate: 台阶过去的泥地能吞没一只靴子。黑暗中没人能找到外面的老路。
content.fx.trig.spine-sealed.0.narrate: 心脏跳动时，这里紧闭着。
content.fx.trig.valve-east.8.narrate: 心脏猛地一缩，地板随之震颤。
content.fx.trig.valve-middle.16.narrate: 心脏猛地一缩，地板随之震颤。
content.fx.trig.valve-west.2.narrate: 心猛地一挤，地面随之一震。
content.fx.trig.wool-picture.0.narrate: 戴维的画，用彩色羊毛织成：满月下，一个黑色的形体躺在黑泥上，一个小小的人影朝它走去。

content.obj.marrack.hear-marrack.hint: 打捞艇停在路边，过了沉船区。
content.obj.marrack.hear-marrack.title: 与马拉克船长交谈
content.obj.marrack.past-the-pillars.hint: 从打捞艇到雕花立石的那条路上。
content.obj.marrack.past-the-pillars.title: 走过石柱
content.obj.the-brow.cut-the-stone.hint: 额头处那块高耸的雕花石，在头顶过去一点的地方。把剥皮铲对准它。
content.obj.the-brow.cut-the-stone.missing_item_: 深嵌在肉里。你需要剥皮铲才能把它切下来。
content.obj.the-brow.cut-the-stone.title: 切下额石
content.obj.the-brow.the-crown.hint: 从心脏室沿颈内阶梯往上，穿过气孔出去。
content.obj.the-brow.the-crown.title: 爬上头顶
content.obj.the-cathedral.cut-the-diaphragm.hint: 穹顶尽头的那面薄膜壁。把剥皮铲对准它。
content.obj.the-cathedral.cut-the-diaphragm.miss: 这层膜很坚韧。你需要从捕鲸人棚屋拿到剥皮铲。
content.obj.the-cathedral.marracks-men.hint: 有两只，穿着打捞工人的油布衣。
content.obj.the-cathedral.marracks-men.title: 与溺尸战斗
content.obj.the-cathedral.the-cathedral.hint: 走出肋骨走廊，进入远处的拱顶。
content.obj.the-cathedral.the-cathedral.title: 穿过肋骨架堂
content.obj.the-cathedral.the-lice.hint: 它们从肉壁中蜂拥而出。
content.obj.the-cathedral.the-lice.title: 杀死虱子
content.obj.the-cathedral.the-stomach.title: 下到胃里
从马车停靠站走下带顶的台阶，沿主街走到尽头亮着灯的办公室。
content.obj.the-coach-road.the-coach-stop.hint: 悬崖顶部路旁的马车停靠点。
content.obj.the-coach-road.the-coach-stop.title: 下马车
content.obj.the-customs-house.the-chart.title: 阅读海图
content.obj.the-customs-house.the-chip.title: 触碰石片
content.obj.the-customs-house.unlock-customs.hin: 海堤下方沉重的门，把海关大楼钥匙对准它。
content.obj.the-customs-house.unlock-customs.mis: 门锁着。你需要从温娜·科伊尔那里拿到海关大楼钥匙。
content.obj.the-fish-market.into-the-market.hint: 从港口办公室沿楼梯下去，到港口边的有顶市场。
它们从滑道上来，进入市场。
content.obj.the-harbourmistress.hear-wenna.hint: 港务长在港口办公室，在主街尽头。
content.obj.the-harbourmistress.hear-wenna.title: 与温娜·科伊尔交谈
content.obj.the-heart.davey.hint: 从胃部继续向前，到心跳最响处：站在心脏旁的年轻人。
content.obj.the-heart.davey.title: 与戴维·科伊尔交谈
content.obj.the-heart.stop-the-heart.hint: 打开与触手伸出的伤口相对应的阀门。伤口只有在外侧可见：从心脏旁伤口处的泥脊上观察。
content.obj.the-heart.stop-the-heart.title: 停止心脏
content.obj.the-lighthouse.light-the-lamp.hint: 穿过绳棚，沿防波堤，登上塔梯到达灯处。
content.obj.the-lighthouse.light-the-lamp.title: 点亮灯塔的灯
content.obj.the-narrows.out-of-the-skiff.hint: 小船已停靠在对岸渡口小屋的码头。
content.obj.the-narrows.out-of-the-skiff.title: 下船
content.obj.the-narrows.the-far-landing.hint: 走出远处的渡船屋，登上岸。
content.obj.the-narrows.the-far-landing.title: 上岸
content.obj.the-narrows.the-jaw.hint: 沿着岸边走到头下方张开的嘴。
content.obj.the-narrows.the-jaw.title: 前往嘴部
content.obj.the-narrows.the-narrows.hint: 沿着路向前，走到开阔水域之间山脊收窄处。
content.obj.the-narrows.the-narrows.title: 穿越狭口
content.obj.the-narrows.the-skiff-stage.hint: 在路尽头石台上的渡船屋里。用舵柄渡过去。
content.obj.the-narrows.the-skiff-stage.title: 登上小船
content.obj.the-pier.the-choice.hint: 温娜和戴维·科伊尔在港口的码头尽头等着。
content.obj.the-pier.the-choice.title: 在码头做出决定
content.obj.the-rubbing.hear-tregear.hint: 从鱼市沿码头走，过海堤台阶，到后面的石头礼拜堂。
content.obj.the-rubbing.hear-tregear.title: 与阿布萨隆·特雷加尔交谈
content.obj.the-run.across.title: 渡回去
content.obj.the-run.along-the-bank.hint: 沿着岸边经过灯柱，前往渡船屋。
content.obj.the-run.along-the-bank.title: 沿着岸边奔跑
content.obj.the-run.down-the-back.hint: 从头部沿着背部向下，到尾部后面的岸边。
content.obj.the-run.down-the-back.title: 沿着背部向下跑
content.obj.the-run.the-causeway.hint: 沿朝圣者之路返回滑道阶梯。
content.obj.the-run.the-causeway.title: 沿堤道走回家
content.obj.the-run.the-landing.hint: 岸尽头的渡船屋。戴维·科伊尔在小船里等着；用舵柄。
content.obj.the-run.the-landing.title: 到达小船
content.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-hull-drowned.hi: 在港口淤泥中搁浅的船只之间。
content.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-shipwright-note: 从海关楼沿台阶下来，在排干水的港口里的棚屋上。
content.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-spade.hint: 在捕鲸人棚屋的架子上，穿过拱门，经过船。
content.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-spade.title: 取走剥脂铲
content.obj.the-throat.into-the-mouth.hint: 进入嘴里，踏上舌头，经过牙齿上粉笔画的箭头。
content.obj.the-throat.into-the-mouth.title: 从齿间进入
content.obj.the-throat.the-wrong-rib.hint: 过嘴后的肋骨走廊里，有根断肋和别的对不上。
content.obj.the-throat.the-wrong-rib.title: 打断错位的肋骨
content.obj.the-wreck-field.onto-the-flat.hint: 从滑道阶梯出发，跟着点亮的木桩穿过泥滩。
content.obj.the-wreck-field.onto-the-flat.title: 走朝圣者之路
content.obj.the-wreck-field.wenna-at-the-stair.h: 沿防波堤返回，穿过港口，到通往滩涂的石阶。
content.obj.the-wreck-field.wenna-at-the-stair.t: 在滑道阶梯与温娜会合
content.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-first.hint: 溺尸从你周围的船壳里爬出来。
content.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-first.title: 击退溺尸
content.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-second.hint: 更多溺尸正从船壳里爬出来。
content.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-second.title: 击退溺尸
content.quest.marrack.goal: 在打捞船长的船旁与他会面，取走他的航海日志并借用他的小艇，然后穿过雕刻石柱。
content.quest.the-brow.goal: 沿脊柱攀上头顶，切下眉骨石。
content.quest.the-cathedral.goal: 穿过肋骨大教堂，切开横膈膜，到达胃部。
content.quest.the-coach-road.goal: 到达马车道，选择你的身份，俯瞰拉克姆和泥滩。
content.quest.the-customs-house.goal: 用女港务长的钥匙打开海关：取旧路海图和石头碎片。
content.quest.the-fish-market.goal: 击退从滑道上来的溺尸，守住鱼市。
content.quest.the-harbourmistress.goal: 找到在报纸上登启事的女港务长，听她讲述镇上正经历的事。
content.quest.the-heart.goal: 找到心脏旁的戴维，用三个瓣膜让心脏停跳。
content.quest.the-lighthouse.goal: 点亮灯塔，让旧路的灯标照亮泥滩路，然后下到滑道阶梯。
content.quest.the-narrows.goal: 穿过海峡，乘小艇渡过黑水，到达身体的颌部。
content.quest.the-pier.goal: 在码头上决定如何处置眉骨石。
content.quest.the-rubbing.goal: 让镇上的档案员在海员礼拜堂解读眉骨石拓片。
content.quest.the-run.goal: 跑过背部和河岸，到小艇处，与戴维一起渡水，然后沿堤道走回家。
content.quest.the-shut-harbour.goal: 弄清为什么船都出不了港，从捕鲸人小屋拿走剥脂铲。
content.quest.the-throat.goal: 找到离开无尽喉咙的路。
content.quest.the-wreck-field.goal: 沿朝圣者之路走出去，在沉船场击退溺尸。

source.class.physician.blurb: Support. Throws splash potions of healing over the party; a sword and light leather armour.
source.class.physician.name: Physician
source.class.reporter.blurb: Ranged fighter. A crossbow from behind the line, a sword for close work, and a spyglass for looking.
source.class.reporter.name: Reporter
source.class.scholar.blurb: Light fighter. A sword, leather and chain armour, and a brush for old carvings.
source.class.scholar.kit.5.name: Scholar's Brush
source.class.scholar.name: Scholar
source.class.veteran.blurb: Front-line fighter. Sword, shield and heavy iron armour: slow, and very hard to kill.
source.class.veteran.name: Veteran
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-carvers.text: "A people nobody remembers, before the town. Under the second panel there's a line in their own script. I've never been able to read it."
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-panels.text: "People driving the stone into its head. Then the Fathomer asleep, and dreaming, and the dream reaching the shore. Then the stone lifted, and the Fathomer going down into the trench. That's what lifting the stone does: it sends it down."
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-row.text: "The bottom row. It was broken off before my grandfather's time. I don't know what it showed. That frightens me more than the rest of it."
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-rubbing.text: "Wenna sent you. Then I'll tell you. This is the Rubbing: my grandfather took it from a piece of the Brow Stone, the carved stone that's driven into the Fathomer's head. The bottom of it is broken off."
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.opt.0.label: She's waiting.
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.text: "I don't know how I got here. I don't remember any of it. Is my mother all right?"
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.opt.0.label: Davey. Your mother.
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.text: Davey stands by the heart with his eyes open. "It's warm here. It's dreaming, and we dream it. Lie down. Lie down beside it, it's nearly time."
source.dlg.davey-home.davey-home.text: "I don't remember the flat, or any of it. Mother says you came a long way for me. Thank you."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.opt.0.label: How do we get across?
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.text: "Then you're going inside. I went in. The mouth's open at the low end. I took two men in with me and I came out alone, and they're still in there. I don't know if they're alive."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.opt.0.tool: Marrack lends you his skiff and gives you his log.
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.text: "My skiff's in the old ferry house at the end of the road. Take it. Take my log too; it's what I saw. If you find my men, bring them out."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.opt.0.label: We're looking for a boy.
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.text: "Ivo Marrack. Salvage, out of Penhallow. Came by sea three days ago to strip the thing before anyone else could."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.0.label: We're looking for a boy.
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.1.label: Who are you?
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.text: "Another crew after the carcass? Turn round." He looks at you properly. "...No. You're not salvage."
source.dlg.sleeper-lofts.sleeper-lofts.text: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.sleeper-ropewalk.sleeper-ropewalk.te: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.sleeper-street-1.sleeper-street-1.te: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.sleeper-street-2.sleeper-street-2.te: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.text: "Everyone in Wrackham dreams the same dream now. You walk out on the mud and lie down beside it. And then people do it, asleep. Most of them we find at dawn standing at the edge of the water. Three walked into it. Davey is one of the three. I'm afraid of that dream. I'm afraid to sleep."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-fathomer.text: "An old Wrackham name for what sleeps in the trench off the bay. There's a stone in its head, they say. Absalom Tregear at the chapel knows what the stone is. Ask him."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.0.label: The Fathomer?
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.text: "Four nights ago the bottom of the bay came up. Two miles of black mud, right across the harbour mouth. And something came up with it, out at the far edge. It's the size of a hill. The old people call it the Fathomer."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.0.label: What is out on the flat?
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.1.label: In his sleep?
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.2.label: We'll find him.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.text: "You came. Good. I'm Wenna Coyle, harbourmistress; I put the notice in the papers. My son Davey walked out onto the flat four nights ago in his sleep and didn't come back."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.label: Keep it.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.tooltip: Tregear locks the stone in the chapel crypt, where nobody can ever put it back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.label: Give it back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.tooltip: The stone goes off the end of the pier, into the sea it came from.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.text: "You brought him back." She has hold of Davey's arm and doesn't let go. "That stone. Tregear says if it goes back in the sea, the thing goes back down. If you keep it, nobody can ever put it back. It's yours to say."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-slipway.text: "The lamps are lit. That's the old road; it doesn't sink, they say. Follow the stakes out to the black water. Bring him back."
The moon has gone red. Run.
source.fx.the-cathedral.oc.the-stomach.0.narrat: On the shore of a black pool: two lamps, a boot, a coil of rope, two coats.
source.fx.the-coach-road.oc.the-coach-stop.1.na: a fishing town on Wrack Bay
source.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chart.0.narr: The chart shows a road across the bay from before the town: the Pilgrims' Way. Stakes mark it. The lighthouse lit them, once.
source.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chip.0.seq.1: For a moment you are walking out over warm black mud, and you want to lie down beside something.
source.fx.the-fish-market.done.2.narrate: The sky over the seawall turns.
source.fx.the-harbourmistress.done.1.narrate: Wenna Coyle gives you the Customs House key.
source.fx.the-heart.oc.davey.2.narrate: Three valves in the heart wall. Outside, a tentacle has risen from one of the wounds in the flank.
source.fx.the-lighthouse.oc.light-the-lamp.6.na: Lamps come on across the flat.
source.fx.the-lighthouse.oc.light-the-lamp.7.na: Out on the mud a line of lamps runs to the black water. The yellow fog now covers the whole lower town.
source.fx.the-narrows.oc.the-narrows.3.narrate: A tentacle rises out of a pit in the mud beside the way, and strikes the shelf beside it.
source.fx.the-pier.done.0.seq.1.0.narrate: At dawn the town is clear and the bay is fog. Nobody in Wrackham dreams. Tregear does not sleep: under his chapel the stone dreams, and he hears it.
source.fx.the-pier.done.1.seq.1.0.narrate: Going down, the stone shows its bottom row for the first time: Wrackham, under water. At dawn the fog has not lifted. Nobody in Wrackham dreams.
source.fx.the-run.oc.the-causeway.3.narrate: The fog lifts off the town.
source.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-shipwright-no: The note: the flat closed the harbour mouth the night of the rising. No boat goes out of Wrackham. The only boat on the far side is the salvage launch of a captain called Marrack, who came by sea three days ago.
source.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-spade.1.narra: The Flensing Spade: a long whaler's blade, sharp enough to cut a stone out of flesh.
source.fx.the-throat.oc.into-the-mouth.0.narrat: A chalk arrow on a tooth points inward. Marrack came this way.
source.fx.the-wreck-field.done.3.narrate: The mud beside the way sinks.
source.fx.the-wreck-field.done.4.narrate: The open mud on both sides of the way sinks. Sea water stands where it was.
source.fx.trig.cathedral-tentacle-east-struck.3: The tentacle draws back down into the dark and stays down.
source.fx.trig.cathedral-tentacle-west-struck.3: The tentacle draws back down into the dark and stays down.

source.obj.marrack.hear-marrack.hint: The salvage launch grounded beside the way, past the wreck field.
source.obj.marrack.hear-marrack.title: Speak with Captain Marrack
source.obj.marrack.past-the-pillars.hint: Along the way from the launch to the carved standing stones.
source.obj.marrack.past-the-pillars.title: Walk on past the pillars
source.obj.the-brow.cut-the-stone.hint: The tall carved stone in the forehead, past the top of the head. Hold the Flensing Spade to it.
source.obj.the-brow.cut-the-stone.missing_item_: Driven deep into the flesh. You need the Flensing Spade to cut it out.
source.obj.the-brow.cut-the-stone.title: Cut out the Brow Stone
source.obj.the-brow.the-crown.hint: Up the stair inside the neck from the heart chamber and out through the blowhole.
source.obj.the-brow.the-crown.title: Climb to the top of the head
source.obj.the-cathedral.cut-the-diaphragm.hint: The wall of membrane at the far end of the vault. Hold the Flensing Spade to it.
source.obj.the-cathedral.cut-the-diaphragm.miss: Tough membrane. You need the Flensing Spade from the whalers' shed.
source.obj.the-cathedral.marracks-men.hint: Two of them, in salvage men's oilskins.
source.obj.the-cathedral.marracks-men.title: Fight the Drowned
source.obj.the-cathedral.the-cathedral.hint: Out of the corridor of ribs into the vault beyond.
source.obj.the-cathedral.the-cathedral.title: Cross the Rib Cathedral
source.obj.the-cathedral.the-lice.hint: They swarm out of the flesh walls.
source.obj.the-cathedral.the-lice.title: Kill the lice
source.obj.the-cathedral.the-stomach.hint: Through the cut in the diaphragm.
source.obj.the-cathedral.the-stomach.title: Go down into the stomach
Down the covered steps from the coach stop and down the high street to the lit office at the bottom.
source.obj.the-coach-road.the-coach-stop.hint: The coach stop on the road at the top of the cliff.
source.obj.the-coach-road.the-coach-stop.title: Get down from the coach
source.obj.the-customs-house.the-chart.hint: The chart pinned behind the counter.
source.obj.the-customs-house.the-chart.title: Read the chart
source.obj.the-customs-house.the-chip.hint: Under the glass on the counter.
source.obj.the-customs-house.the-chip.title: Touch the chip of stone
source.obj.the-customs-house.unlock-customs.hin: The heavy door below the seawall. Hold the Customs House key to it.
source.obj.the-customs-house.unlock-customs.mis: Locked. You need the Customs House key from Wenna Coyle.
source.obj.the-fish-market.into-the-market.hint: Down the stair from the Harbour Office to the covered market by the harbour.
source.obj.the-fish-market.into-the-market.titl: Go down to the fish market
They come up the slipway into the market.
source.obj.the-harbourmistress.hear-wenna.hint: The harbourmistress in the Harbour Office at the bottom of the high street.
source.obj.the-harbourmistress.hear-wenna.title: Speak with Wenna Coyle
source.obj.the-heart.davey.hint: On from the stomach to where the heartbeat is loudest: the young man standing by the heart.
source.obj.the-heart.davey.title: Speak with Davey Coyle
source.obj.the-heart.stop-the-heart.hint: Open the valve that matches the wound a tentacle rises from. The wound shows only outside: watch it from the mud ridge through the wound beside the heart.
source.obj.the-heart.stop-the-heart.title: Stop the heart
source.obj.the-lighthouse.light-the-lamp.hint: Through the rope shed, along the breakwater and up the tower stair to the lamp.
source.obj.the-lighthouse.light-the-lamp.title: Light the lighthouse lamp
source.obj.the-narrows.out-of-the-skiff.hint: The skiff has come to the far ferry house's slip.
source.obj.the-narrows.out-of-the-skiff.title: Get out of the skiff
source.obj.the-narrows.the-far-landing.hint: Out of the far ferry house onto the bank.
source.obj.the-narrows.the-far-landing.title: Go ashore
source.obj.the-narrows.the-jaw.hint: Along the bank to the open mouth under the head.
source.obj.the-narrows.the-jaw.title: Go to the mouth
source.obj.the-narrows.the-narrows.hint: On along the way where the ridge narrows between open water.
source.obj.the-narrows.the-narrows.title: Cross the Narrows
source.obj.the-narrows.the-skiff-stage.hint: In the ferry house on the stone stage at the end of the way. Use its tiller to cross.
source.obj.the-narrows.the-skiff-stage.title: Get into the skiff
source.obj.the-pier.the-choice.hint: Wenna and Davey are waiting at the end of the pier in the harbour.
source.obj.the-pier.the-choice.title: Decide on the pier
source.obj.the-rubbing.hear-tregear.hint: Along the quay from the fish market, over the seawall steps, to the stone chapel past them.
source.obj.the-rubbing.hear-tregear.title: Speak with Absalom Tregear
source.obj.the-run.across.hint: Use the tiller in the ferry house.
source.obj.the-run.across.title: Cross back
source.obj.the-run.along-the-bank.hint: Along the bank past the lamp stakes toward the ferry house.
source.obj.the-run.along-the-bank.title: Run along the bank
source.obj.the-run.down-the-back.hint: Down the back from the head to the bank behind the tail.
source.obj.the-run.down-the-back.title: Run down the back
source.obj.the-run.the-causeway.hint: Back along the Pilgrims' Way to the slipway stair.
source.obj.the-run.the-causeway.title: Walk home along the causeway
source.obj.the-run.the-landing.hint: The ferry house at the end of the bank. Davey is waiting in the skiff; use its tiller.
source.obj.the-run.the-landing.title: Reach the skiff
source.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-hull-drowned.hi: Among the boats lying on the harbour mud.
source.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-shipwright-note: On the shed in the emptied harbour, down the stair from the Customs House.
source.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-spade.hint: On its rack in the whalers' shed, through the arch past the boats.
source.obj.the-shut-harbour.the-spade.title: Take the Flensing Spade
source.obj.the-throat.into-the-mouth.hint: Into the mouth, onto the tongue, past the chalk arrow on a tooth.
source.obj.the-throat.into-the-mouth.title: Go in through the teeth
source.obj.the-throat.the-wrong-rib.hint: In the corridor of ribs past the mouth: the one broken rib that does not match the others.
source.obj.the-throat.the-wrong-rib.title: Break the rib set wrong
source.obj.the-wreck-field.onto-the-flat.hint: Follow the lit stakes out across the mud from the slipway stair.
source.obj.the-wreck-field.onto-the-flat.title: Walk the Pilgrims' Way
source.obj.the-wreck-field.wenna-at-the-stair.h: Back along the breakwater and through the harbour to the stone stair onto the flat.
source.obj.the-wreck-field.wenna-at-the-stair.t: Meet Wenna at the slipway stair
source.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-first.hint: They climb out of the hulls around you.
source.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-first.title: Fight off the Drowned
source.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-second.hint: More are climbing out of the hulls.
source.obj.the-wreck-field.wrecks-second.title: Fight off the Drowned
source.quest.marrack.goal: Meet the salvage captain at his launch, take his log and the use of his skiff, and pass the carved pillars.
source.quest.the-brow.goal: Climb the spine to the top of the head and cut the Brow Stone out.
source.quest.the-cathedral.goal: Cross the Rib Cathedral, cut through the diaphragm and reach the stomach.
source.quest.the-coach-road.goal: Arrive on the coach road, choose who you are, and look down on Wrackham and the flat.
source.quest.the-customs-house.goal: Open the Customs House with the harbourmistress's key: the chart of the old road, and the chip of the stone.
source.quest.the-fish-market.goal: Fight off the Drowned coming up the slipway into the fish market.
source.quest.the-harbourmistress.goal: Find the harbourmistress who put the notice in the papers, and hear what the town is living through.
source.quest.the-heart.goal: Find Davey by the heart, and stop the heart with the three valves.
source.quest.the-lighthouse.goal: Light the lighthouse lamp, so the old road's lamps show the way across the flat, and go down to the slipway stair.
source.quest.the-narrows.goal: Cross the Narrows, take the skiff over the black water, and reach the jaw of the body.
source.quest.the-pier.goal: Decide on the pier what to do with the Brow Stone.
source.quest.the-rubbing.goal: Have the town archivist read the Rubbing of the Brow Stone in the Seamen's Chapel.
source.quest.the-run.goal: Run the back and the bank to the skiff, cross with Davey, and walk the causeway home.
source.quest.the-shut-harbour.goal: Learn why no boat can leave the harbour, and take the Flensing Spade from the Whalers' Shed.
source.quest.the-throat.goal: Find the way out of the endless throat.
source.quest.the-wreck-field.goal: Walk out on the Pilgrims' Way and fight through the Drowned in the wreck field.
